release_notes: SSL management for domains is rebuilt: certificate coverage is verified per domain, custom SSL certificates and keys can be uploaded in domain settings, nginx gets an HTTPS server block with a self-signed certificate for domains that are neither Let's Encrypt nor behind Cloudflare, and the Cloudflare Full (Strict) setup is documented; a 279-line nginx-config regression test locks the generated vhost shape. AN EXISTING NGINX SERVER NEEDS `sudo php /var/www/orbitra/cli/nginx_sync.php` ONCE to pick up the new vhost blocks. IP access control was reworked, and the traffic log now extracts SUBID values from click parameters — covered by new tests on the click path and LeadForge. A shared bulk-file-upload component with CSV parsing and per-file error handling lands in Bot Settings, Branding, Campaigns, Landings, Offers and Traffic Sources. The frontend bundle is rebuilt with this release, shipping the SSL and bulk-upload interfaces that had been committed without a dist rebuild.
